instruction: Senarai fail macOS termasuk tersembunyi (mac) / List files on macOS including hidden
output:
Melayu: Di macOS guna ls -la sama seperti Linux; tambah -G untuk warna. English: same ls -la as Linux; add -G for color.
```bash
ls -laG
```

instruction: Bina dan jalankan skrip macOS guna tool / Build and run a mac script with tools
Senarai direktori di Windows CMD (nt) / List directory on Windows CMD
output:
Melayu: CMD guna dir, bukan ls. English: CMD uses dir, not ls.
```bat
dir /a
cd /d D:\projek
dir
```

instruction: Bina dan jalankan batch CMD guna tool / Build and run a CMD batch with tools
Senarai fail di PowerShell (ps) / List files in PowerShell
output:
Melayu: PowerShell guna Get-ChildItem, alias ls/dir. English: uses Get-ChildItem, aliases ls/dir.
```powershell
Get-ChildItem -Force
Set-Location D:\projek
```

Cetak teks dalam VBScript (vb) / Print text in VBScript
output:
Melayu: VBScript guna WScript.Echo untuk cetak. English: uses WScript.Echo to print.
```vb

```
